column1: # Word list for the classifier's quality gate (job 32a, Spec #8 AC4): text<TAB>seed_key<TAB>kind.
# kind: word (a common grocery word, spelled right), misspelling (a realistic typo of one),
# variant (regional German or English), negative (no grocery word: must stay in "other").
# ./wordlist.sh classifies each row on the local stack and prints the rates; the db gate fails when
# misspellings are under 90% right or more than 1% of all rows land in a wrong category.
# A misspelling the classifier leaves in "other" is a miss, not a false match.
# Placement follows dictionary.tsv (Thunfisch and Kaffee are pantry, Katzenfutter household).
# Not groceries, or nothing the dictionary knows: stay in Sonstiges
